Name: Overdriven
Overview:
Take the Overdriven ship and save the galaxy from an unknown enemy.

1 to 4 Players (Local Co-op), 7 Stages, 7 Secret Items, 7 Challenges, 6 Bosses, 3 Difficulties, 35 Alien Artefacts to find, 20 Awards, Local Highscores, 9 Ship's Levels with Upgrades and Weapons!

Original Gameplay elements (Dynamic Occluders, QTE, Puzzle), Instrumental Soundtrack available from the game Menu.
